title: Functional antibody responses and protection against symptomatic dengue
abstract: Exposure to dengue virus (DENV) triggers the development of anti-viral antibodies that may contribute to either protection or disease progression. Antibodies exist in different isotypes and subtypes, with diverse specificities and functions. IgG antibodies are produced during primary and secondary DENV infections, where they play a role central role in mediating protective immunity, and may also contribute to antibody-dependent enhancement in a secondary heterotypic infection. Although IgG antibodies are widely recognised as key mediators of protective immune responses during DENV infection, antibody specificities, types and functions that reliably correlate with protection remain unclear. A better understanding of anti-DENV antibodies and their roles in protection against symptomatic dengue is essential especially in guiding the design of dengue vaccines. In this review, antibody functions and effector mechanisms in DENV infection are discussed, with a focus on naturally acquired immunity and neutralising antibody responses following vaccination. In addition, current knowledge gaps in antibody functions during DENV infection will be highlighted.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of antibody responses in dengue virus infection, focusing on their dual potential to protect against or exacerbate the disease. It highlights the importance of IgG antibodies in both protective immunity and antibody-dependent enhancement, particularly in secondary heterotypic infections. The review underscores the need for further research to identify specific antibody isotypes, subtypes, and functions that reliably correlate with protection. This understanding is critical for the development of effective dengue vaccines. The review also discusses the current state of knowledge on antibody functions and effector mechanisms, emphasizing the significance of naturally acquired immunity and neutralising antibody responses following vaccination.

title: Repeated-Dose High-Dose Ivermectin Pharmacokinetics and Safety in Children with Acute Dengue.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Ivermectin has shown anti-dengue virus activity in experimental systems, and an adult dengue trial found faster clearance of circulating non-structural protein 1 (NS1) without improvement in viremia or clinical outcomes. Pediatric pharmacokinetic and safety data for repeated high-dose regimens remain limited. We characterized repeated-dose ivermectin pharmacokinetics and safety in children with acute uncomplicated dengue weighing ≥15 kg. METHODS: In this prospective, open-label, sequential dose-escalation study, children aged 1-15 years who presented within 72 h of fever onset and met the protocol laboratory-confirmation criteria for dengue received ivermectin 400 or 600 μg/kg once daily for 3 days. Noncompartmental analyses estimated exposure and peak concentrations from intensive plasma sampling. Exploratory analyses examined associations between exposure and viremia and NS1 trajectories during the first 48 h after dose 1; the study was not designed or powered to evaluate antiviral efficacy. RESULTS: All 24 children completed follow-up and experienced at least one adverse event; most events were consistent with acute dengue. Six participants (25%) experienced serious adverse events consisting of grade 4 neutropenia; all participants were clinically well, required no neutropenia-specific treatment, and showed improvement at the next available assessment or follow-up. No serious adverse event was assessed as related to ivermectin. One asymptomatic grade 1 QTc-prolongation adverse event was recorded and required no intervention. Exposure increased with dose: median 0-48-h area under the concentration-time curve (AUClast) was 1316.49 and 2129.41 ng·h/mL at 400 and 600 μg/kg, respectively, and corresponding maximum observed concentrations (Cmax) were 107.50 and 165.50 ng/mL. Dose-normalized parameters showed no clear relationship with body weight. Analyses confined to the first 48 h identified no clear exposure-response association with viremia or NS1 trajectories. CONCLUSIONS: In children weighing ≥15 kg with acute uncomplicated dengue, ivermectin exposure increased with administered dose, while dose-normalized AUClast and Cmax showed no clear relationship with body weight across the studied range. Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Ivermectin in Pediatric Dengue Patients (PKIDEN) therefore fills an important dengue-specific pediatric clinical pharmacology gap and provides repeated-dose exposure and safety reference data that may inform dose selection, exposure interpretation, and safety monitoring in future studies. The study was not designed to determine antiviral efficacy or clinical benefit. TRIAL REGISTRY: ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03432442; first posted February 14, 2018.

We characterized repeated-dose ivermectin pharmacokinetics and safety in children with acute uncomplicated dengue weighing ≥15 kg. In this prospective, open-label, sequential dose-escalation study, children aged 1–15 years who presented within 72 h of fever onset and met the protocol laboratory-confirmation criteria for dengue received ivermectin 400 or 600 μg/kg once daily for 3 days. Noncompartmental analyses estimated exposure and peak concentrations from intensive plasma sampling. Exploratory analyses examined associations between exposure and viremia and NS1 trajectories during the first 48 h after dose 1; the study was not designed or powered to evaluate antiviral efficacy. All 24 children completed follow-up and experienced at least one adverse event; most events were consistent with acute dengue. Six participants (25%) experienced serious adverse events consisting of grade 4 neutropenia; all participants were clinically well, required no neutropenia-specific treatment, and showed improvement at the next available assessment or follow-up. No serious adverse event was assessed as related to ivermectin. One asymptomatic grade 1 QTc-prolongation adverse event was recorded and required no intervention. Exposure increased with dose: median 0–48-h area under the concentration–time curve (AUC last ) was 1316.49 and 2129.41 ng·h/mL at 400 and 600 μg/kg, respectively, and corresponding maximum observed concentrations ( C max ) were 107.50 and 165.50 ng/mL. Dose-normalized parameters showed no clear relationship with body weight. Analyses confined to the first 48 h identified no clear exposure–response association with viremia or NS1 trajectories. In children weighing ≥15 kg with acute uncomplicated dengue, ivermectin exposure increased with administered dose, while dose-normalized AUC last and C max showed no clear relationship with body weight across the studied range. Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Ivermectin in Pediatric Dengue Patients (PKIDEN) therefore fills an important dengue-specific pediatric clinical pharmacology gap and provides repeated-dose exposure and safety reference data that may inform dose selection, exposure interpretation, and safety monitoring in future studies. The study was not designed to determine antiviral efficacy or clinical benefit. ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03432442; first posted February 14, 2018.

A prospective, open-label, sequential dose-escalation study was conducted with 24 children aged 1-15 years who presented within 72 h of fever onset and had laboratory-confirmed dengue. Noncompartmental analyses were used to estimate exposure and peak concentrations, while exploratory analyses examined associations between exposure and viremia or NS1 trajectories. The evidence is moderate due to the study's focus on safety and pharmacokinetics rather than efficacy.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 伊维菌素在实验系统中显示出对登革病毒的抗病毒活性,并且一项成人登革热试验发现,循环非结构蛋白1(NS1)的清除速度加快,但未改善病毒血症或临床结果。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 重复高剂量方案的儿科药代动力学和安全性数据仍然有限。我们研究了体重≥15 kg的儿童在急性非复杂性登革热中重复剂量伊维菌素的药代动力学和安全性。
elements_zh.methods: 本项前瞻性、开放标签、顺序剂量递增研究中,年龄在1-15岁之间、发热后72小时内就诊且符合登革热实验室确认标准的儿童,接受400或600 μg/kg的伊维菌素,每日一次,连续3天。非房室分析基于密集的血浆采样估计暴露量和峰值浓度。探索性分析考察了暴露与病毒血症以及NS1轨迹在剂量1后48小时内之间的关联;该研究未设计或具备评估抗病毒药物疗效的能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有24名儿童均完成了随访,并至少经历了一次不良事件;大多数事件与急性登革热一致。6名参与者(25%)出现了严重的不良事件,包括4级中性粒细胞减少;所有参与者临床状况良好,无需中性粒细胞减少特异性治疗治疗,并在下次可获得的评估或随访中显示出改善。记录了一例无症状的1级QTc延长不良事件,且无需干预。暴露量随剂量增加:400和600 μg/kg剂量下,0-48小时的浓度-时间曲线下面积(AUClast)中位数分别为1316.49和2129.41 ng·h/mL,相应的最大观察浓度(Cmax)分别为107.50和165.50 ng/mL。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 伊维菌素在儿科登革热患者中的药代动力学和药效学(PKIDEN)填补了重要的登革热特异性儿科临床药理学空白,并提供了重复剂量暴露和安全性参考数据,可能有助于未来研究中的剂量选择、暴露解释和安全性监测。该研究未设计用于确定抗病毒药物的疗效或临床益处。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了重复剂量暴露和安全性参考数据,可能有助于未来登革热研究中的剂量选择、暴露解释和安全性监测。它们还强调了需要进一步研究以评估抗病毒药物的疗效和临床益处。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 仅限于前48小时的分析未发现暴露与病毒血症或NS1轨迹之间的明显暴露-反应关联。证据强度中等,因为该研究侧重于药代动力学和安全性,而非疗效。

abstract_zh: 背景与目的:伊维菌素在实验系统中显示出对登革病毒的抗病毒活性,并且一项成人登革热试验发现,循环非结构蛋白1(NS1)的清除速度加快,但未改善病毒血症或临床结果。重复高剂量方案的儿科药代动力学和安全性数据仍然有限。我们研究了体重≥15 kg的儿童在急性非复杂性登革热中重复剂量伊维菌素的药代动力学和安全性。方法:本项前瞻性、开放标签、顺序剂量递增研究中,年龄在1-15岁之间、发热后72小时内就诊且符合登革热实验室确认标准的儿童,接受400或600 μg/kg的伊维菌素,每日一次,连续3天。非房室分析基于密集的血浆采样估计暴露量和峰值浓度。探索性分析考察了暴露与病毒血症以及NS1轨迹在剂量1后48小时内之间的关联;该研究未设计或具备评估抗病毒药物疗效的能力。结果:所有24名儿童均完成了随访,并至少经历了一次不良事件;大多数事件与急性登革热一致。6名参与者(25%)出现了严重的不良事件,包括4级中性粒细胞减少;所有参与者临床状况良好,无需中性粒细胞减少特异性治疗治疗,并在下次可获得的评估或随访中显示出改善。没有严重的不良事件被评估为与伊维菌素有关。记录了一例无症状的1级QTc延长不良事件,且无需干预。暴露量随剂量增加:400和600 μg/kg剂量下,0-48小时的浓度-时间曲线下面积(AUClast)中位数分别为1316.49和2129.41 ng·h/mL,相应的最大观察浓度(Cmax)分别为107.50和165.50 ng/mL。剂量标准化参数与体重之间没有明显关联。仅限于前48小时的分析未发现暴露与病毒血症或NS1轨迹之间的明显暴露-反应关联。结论:在体重≥15 kg的急性非复杂性登革热儿童中,伊维菌素的暴露量随给药剂量增加而增加,而剂量标准化的AUClast和Cmax在研究范围内与体重之间没有明显关联。因此,伊维菌素在儿科登革热患者中的药代动力学和药效学(PKIDEN)填补了重要的登革热特异性儿科临床药理学空白,并提供了重复剂量暴露和安全性参考数据,可能有助于未来研究中的剂量选择、暴露解释和安全性监测。该研究未设计用于确定抗病毒药物的疗效或临床益处。试验注册:ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03432442;首次发布日期为2018年2月14日。

title: Advanced next-generation vaccines for dengue and other flaviviral infections.
abstract: Notifiable flaviviral pathogens, particularly dengue, continue to pose significant health and economic challenges worldwide, especially in tropical regions where these infections remain endemic. In the Philippines, the risk remains high following the 2019 withdrawal of the Dengvaxia vaccine, with no alternative immunization currently available locally. Recent interest in nucleic acid-based immunogens highlights the need for scalable, non-infectious vaccine production platforms; however, generating high-dose DNA constructs capable of inducing effective immune responses without live-virus propagation remains challenging. Our work from 2018 to 2024 addressed this need through the development of computationally designed, cell-free, PCR-amplifiable DNA constructs using algorithmic overlap extension PCR (OE-PCR) and an improved technique, asymmetric extension supported by a simulator for oligonucleotide extension (AESOE). Subsequent integration of machine learning, including recurrent neural network-based amplification prediction and LAMP primer design, further improved synthesis efficiency and expanded applications for surveillance and diagnostics. The AESOE-guided OE-PCR platform enabled the assembly of synthetic flaviviral DNA fragments of at least 1 kilobase in length from overlapping oligonucleotides, supporting scalable production of synthetic immunogens without the need for infectious viral materials. These live-virus-free strategies may enhance biosafety, reduce development timelines, and improve accessibility for laboratories in resource-limited settings, potentially supporting next-generation vaccine development for dengue and other flaviviral diseases.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on dengue virus (DENV) and dengue disease, with an emphasis on developing next-generation vaccines. The central question is about the challenges and opportunities in creating scalable, non-infectious vaccine production platforms for dengue and other flaviviruses.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of methods and findings from 2018 to 2024, highlighting the development of DNA-based vaccine platforms. It describes the use of algorithmic overlap extension PCR (OE-PCR) and an improved technique, asymmetric extension supported by a simulator for oligonucleotide extension (AESOE), to create synthetic DNA constructs. Machine learning tools, including recurrent neural network-based amplification prediction and LAMP primer design, were integrated to enhance synthesis efficiency and expand applications for surveillance and diagnostics.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that recent advancements in nucleic acid-based immunogens have shown promise for scalable, non-infectious vaccine production. However, generating high-dose DNA constructs that can induce effective immune responses without live-virus propagation remains a significant challenge.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while live-virus-free strategies may enhance biosafety and reduce development timelines, the effectiveness of these DNA constructs in inducing robust immune responses is still under investigation. There is a lack of comprehensive data on the long-term efficacy and safety of these platforms in real-world settings.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that further research is needed to optimize DNA construct design and improve the scalability of these platforms. It also highlights the importance of expanding applications for surveillance and diagnostics using these technologies, particularly in resource-limited settings.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the development of next-generation vaccines for dengue virus, emphasizing the use of nucleic acid-based immunogens. It highlights the challenges in creating high-dose DNA constructs that can induce effective immune responses without live-virus propagation. The review describes the use of algorithmic overlap extension PCR (OE-PCR) and an improved technique, asymmetric extension supported by a simulator for oligonucleotide extension (AESOE), to assemble synthetic DNA fragments. Machine learning tools were integrated to enhance synthesis efficiency and expand applications for surveillance and diagnostics. While live-virus-free strategies offer potential benefits in biosafety and accessibility, the review identifies gaps in long-term efficacy and safety data. It suggests future research should focus on optimizing DNA construct design and improving scalability, particularly for resource-limited settings.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对2018年至2024年间方法和发现的叙述性综合,强调了基于DNA的疫苗平台的开发。它描述了使用算法重叠延伸PCR(OE-PCR)和一种改进技术,即由寡核苷酸延伸模拟器支持的非对称延伸(AESOE)来创建合成DNA构建体的过程。还整合了机器学习工具,包括基于循环神经网络的扩增预测和LAMP引物设计,以提高合成效率并扩展监测和诊断的应用范围。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,基于核酸的免疫原近期进展显示出在可扩展、非感染性疫苗生产方面的潜力。然而,生成无需活病毒增殖即可诱导有效免疫应答的高剂量DNA构建体仍然是一个重大挑战。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,尽管无活病毒策略可能提高生物安全性和缩短开发时间,但这些DNA构建体在诱导强效免疫应答方面的有效性仍处于研究阶段。目前缺乏关于这些平台在真实世界环境中长期有效性和安全性的全面数据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议需要进一步研究以优化DNA构建体设计并提高这些平台的可扩展性。它还强调了利用这些技术扩展监测和诊断应用的重要性,特别是在资源匮乏的地区。

abstract_zh: 可报告的黄病毒病原体,特别是登革病毒,继续在全球范围内,尤其是在热带地区这些感染仍属地方性流行病的地区,对健康和经济构成重大挑战。在菲律宾,由于2019年撤回了登革热疫苗疫苗,风险依然很高,目前当地尚无替代的免疫接种方案。最近对基于核酸的免疫原的兴趣凸显了开发可扩展、非感染性的疫苗生产平台的必要性;然而,生成能够诱导有效免疫应答的高剂量DNA构建体,而无需活病毒增殖,仍然面临挑战。我们的2018年至2024年工作通过使用算法重叠延伸PCR(OE-PCR)和一种改进技术,即由寡核苷酸延伸模拟器支持的非对称延伸(AESOE)来设计计算合成的、细胞外可扩增的DNA构建体,解决了这一需求。随后,通过整合机器学习技术,包括基于循环神经网络的扩增预测和LAMP引物设计,进一步提高了合成效率,并扩展了监测和诊断的应用范围。AESOE指导的OE-PCR平台使合成至少1千碱基长度的黄病毒DNA片段成为可能,这些片段由重叠的寡核苷酸组装而成,支持在无需感染性病毒材料的情况下进行可扩展的合成免疫原生产。这些无活病毒策略可能提高生物安全性,缩短开发时间,并改善资源匮乏地区实验室的可及性,从而可能支持登革热及其他黄病毒的下一代疫苗开发。

analysis.research_question_and_background: A very strong El Niño is arriving over a Latin American population with little DENV-3 immunity. This creates a critical need to understand the potential impact of the climate event on dengue disease outbreaks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focuses on the Latin American population during the upcoming El Niño event of 2026-27, which is expected to influence dengue virus transmission dynamics. The population has limited immunity to DENV-3, making it particularly vulnerable.
analysis.methods: The study uses climate modeling and epidemiological data to predict the potential impact of the El Niño event on dengue virus transmission. It also incorporates historical outbreak data and immunological surveys to assess the population's susceptibility.
analysis.main_results: The study reports that the upcoming El Niño event is likely to increase the risk of DENV-3 outbreaks in Latin America due to the population's low immunity levels. It highlights the need for immediate preparedness measures.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the El Niño event provides a narrow window for implementing preventive measures against DENV-3 outbreaks. This is a novel insight into the interplay between climate patterns and dengue disease dynamics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for surveillance, vector control, and clinical preparedness in Latin America during the El Niño event. They emphasize the importance of differentiating DENV-3 outbreaks from other flaviviruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on predictive modeling and historical data, which may have limitations in capturing real-time transmission dynamics. However, the evidence is considered moderate due to the integration of multiple data sources.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the potential impact of the upcoming El Niño event on DENV-3 outbreaks in Latin America, where the population has limited immunity. It highlights the need for immediate preparedness measures, including strengthening vector control, differentiating outbreaks from other flaviviruses, and enhancing clinical capacity. The authors interpret that the El Niño event presents a critical opportunity for intervention, offering a novel perspective on climate-disease interactions. The findings have significant implications for public health planning, particularly in regions with low DENV-3 immunity. However, the study's reliance on predictive models and historical data limits the confidence in its conclusions, resulting in a moderate evidence assessment.

title: Optimal Control of Dengue under Vaccine Heterogeneity: From Dynamical Analysis to Dynamic Strategy Optimization.
abstract: The protective efficacy of dengue vaccines differs between susceptible and recovered individuals, while antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) from vaccination may increase severe disease risk. Most studies treat ADE and vaccine allocation separately, lacking tools for dynamic cross-strategy comparison. We develop a dengue transmission model incorporating ADE effects and time delays. Using this model, we derive the basic reproduction number and establish equilibrium stability conditions. An optimal control framework is developed that integrates vaccine heterogeneity into a composite objective functional, balancing health losses, secondary infection penalties, and intervention costs. On a baseline calibrated to R 0 =1.515, we identify three key findings. First, targeted vaccination yields the lowest total societal cost while achieving health outcomes close to the ideal vaccine. Second, the ideal vaccine is cost-dominant when its daily price remains below $1 per capita. Third, the risky vaccine incurs higher long-term costs due to ADE-driven late-stage health loss, despite its lower procurement price. Sensitivity analysis reveals a price crossover threshold and strategy-specific responses to cost fluctuations, providing quantitative guidance for vaccine selection under varying resource constraints.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决在疫苗异质性下的登革热最优控制问题,特别是针对易感者和康复者之间保护效果的差异,以及抗体依赖性增强(抗体依赖性增强,ADE)可能增加重症疾病风险的挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究开发了一个包含ADE效应和时间延迟的登革热传播模型,并利用该模型推导了基本再生数并建立了平衡状态的稳定性条件。
elements_zh.methods: 构建了一个最优控制框架,将疫苗的异质性整合到一个综合目标函数中,以平衡健康损失、二次感染惩罚和干预成本。
elements_zh.main_results: 在以R 0 =1.515为基准的校准基础上,识别出三个关键发现:针对疫苗接种的定向措施产生了最低的总社会成本,同时实现了接近理想疫苗的健康成果;当理想疫苗的每日价格保持在每人1美元以下时,其成本占优;而风险型疫苗由于抗体依赖性增强(ADE)驱动的晚期健康损失,导致长期成本更高,尽管其采购价格较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为在不同资源约束条件下选择疫苗的定量指导,强调了在动态策略优化中考虑疫苗异质性和ADE效应的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过提供基于成本和健康结果的疫苗选择框架,为登革热控制的公共卫生策略提供信息,特别是在资源有限的环境中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括依赖于校准的基准模型以及缺乏真实世界数据,这可能影响结果的普遍适用性。由于模型的理论性质和所作假设,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决在疫苗异质性下的登革热最优控制问题,特别是针对易感者和康复者之间保护效果的差异,以及抗体依赖性增强(抗体依赖性增强,ADE)可能增加重症疾病风险的挑战。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究开发了一个包含ADE效应和时间延迟的登革热传播模型,并利用该模型推导了基本再生数并建立了平衡状态的稳定性条件。
analysis_zh.methods: 构建了一个最优控制框架,将疫苗的异质性整合到一个综合目标函数中,以平衡健康损失、二次感染惩罚和干预成本。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在以R 0 =1.515为基准的校准基础上,识别出三个关键发现:针对疫苗接种的定向措施产生了最低的总社会成本,同时实现了接近理想疫苗的健康成果;当理想疫苗的每日价格保持在每人1美元以下时,其成本占优;而风险型疫苗由于抗体依赖性增强(ADE)驱动的晚期健康损失,导致长期成本更高,尽管其采购价格较低。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为在不同资源约束条件下选择疫苗的定量指导,强调了在动态策略优化中考虑疫苗异质性和ADE效应的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过提供基于成本和健康结果的疫苗选择框架,为登革热控制的公共卫生策略提供信息,特别是在资源有限的环境中。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括依赖于校准的基准模型以及缺乏真实世界数据,这可能影响结果的普遍适用性。由于模型的理论性质和所作假设,证据强度中等。

title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

analysis_zh.methods: 通过功能实验评估提取物的抗病毒药物活性,从而分离并表征四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷。
analysis_zh.main_results: 五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。分离出的化合物抑制了DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些化合物可能为开发新的抗病毒药物疗法提供信息,用于登革热及其他虫媒病毒的治疗,从而潜在地减少这些感染的全球健康负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅使用了一种DENV-2菌株,并缺乏体内验证,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。

title: The Impact of the 2023–2025 Conflict on Malaria and Dengue Transmission in Sudan: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
abstract: The Sudanese conflict has significantly changed the operating environment for disease control since April 2023. The dynamics of malaria and dengue transmission have changed as a result of widespread population migration, deteriorated water and sanitation infrastructure, and the cessation of regular vector control operations. We conducted a thorough search for research published between April 2023 and September 2025 in the PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, PMC, and WHO databases. Included were studies on co-infection, dengue, or malaria in Sudan. When possible, random-effects meta-analysis was used in conjunction with narrative synthesis. Thirty-four studies satisfied the requirements for inclusion. In 2024, about 3.5 million cases of malaria were reported. Kassala confirmed the co-circulation of all four DENV serotypes as dengue outbreaks spread to 12 states. The incidence of co-infection varied from 6.6% to 15%. Displacement, decreased functionality of medical facilities, and disruption of vector control were important factors. Early viability was demonstrated by interventions including the introduction of the R21/Matrix-M vaccination and AI-assisted clinical decision support. The combination of population displacement, environmental changes, and disrupted health services has increased the paths via which both illnesses are transmitted. To handle the changing burden, context-adapted methods are needed.

title: Clinical and Molecular Associations of Il-1β, Tnf-α, and Il-8 Polymorphisms in Dengue Patients
abstract: Abstract Background Dengue is a major arboviral disease where polymorphisms in genes encoding inflammatory mediators may modulate the immune response to dengue virus (DENV) infection. Thus, this study aimed to investigate the association of IL-1β rs1143634, IL-8 rs4073, and TNF-α rs361525 polymorphisms with susceptibility to DENV infection and with clinical manifestations and laboratory parameters. Methods A case-control study was conducted in Goiânia, Goiás, Brazil, including individuals with confirmed DENV infection. Genomic IL-1β rs1143634, IL-8 rs4073, and TNF-α rs361525 polymorphisms were genotyped using TaqMan assays and real-time PCR. Logistic regression, Fisher's exact test, and Student's t -test were used for statistical analyses. Clinical and laboratory data were evaluated according to genotype. Results No significant association was observed between the evaluated polymorphisms and susceptibility to DENV infection ( p > 0.05). Similarly, no significant association was observed between polymorphisms and the overall number of clinical symptoms. However, the IL-8 rs4073 polymorphism was significantly associated with serum aminotransferase levels, AST (p = 0.002) and ALT (p = 0.040). The TNF-α rs361525 polymorphism was significantly associated with platelet count ( p IL-1β rs1143634 was significantly associated with low back pain ( p = 0.040). Conclusion The association between IL-8 rs4073 and AST and ALT levels suggests a potential role of this polymorphism in hepatic involvement during dengue. Furthermore, the association of TNF-α rs361525 with thrombocytopenia and IL-1β rs1143634 with low back pain further supports the potential contribution of inflammatory genetic variants to the clinical heterogeneity of dengue. Larger studies are required for underlying biological mechanisms.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association of IL-1β rs1143634, IL-8 rs4073, and TNF-α rs361525 polymorphisms with susceptibility to DENV infection and clinical manifestations. A case-control study was conducted in Goiânia, Brazil, using TaqMan assays and real-time PCR to genotype these polymorphisms. Statistical analyses included logistic regression, Fisher's exact test, and Student's t-test. The results showed no significant association with susceptibility or overall clinical symptoms, but IL-8 rs4073 was linked to elevated AST and ALT levels, TNF-α rs361525 with thrombocytopenia, and IL-1β rs1143634 with low back pain. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是一种重要的虫媒病毒疾病,编码炎症介质的基因多态性可能调节登革病毒(DENV)感染。本研究旨在探讨IL-1β rs1143634、IL-8 rs4073和TNF-α rs361525多态性与登革病毒感染易感性以及临床表现和实验室参数之间的关联。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在巴西戈亚斯州戈亚尼亚市进行,包括确诊登革病毒感染的个体。研究评估了根据基因型的临床和实验室数据。
elements_zh.methods: 使用TaqMan检测和实时PCR对基因组中的IL-1β rs1143634、IL-8 rs4073和TNF-α rs361525多态性进行基因分型。采用逻辑回归、Fisher精确检验和Student t检验进行统计分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 未观察到所评估的多态性与登革病毒感染易感性之间存在显著关联(p > 0.05)。然而,IL-8 rs4073多态性与血清转氨酶水平显著相关,AST(p = 0.002)和ALT(p = 0.040)。TNF-α rs361525多态性与血小板计数(p = 0.015)显著相关,IL-1β rs1143634多态性与腰痛(p = 0.040)显著相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: IL-8 rs4073与AST和ALT水平的关联表明该多态性可能在登革热期间的肝脏受累中起潜在作用。此外,TNF-α rs361525与血小板减少以及IL-1β rs1143634与腰痛的关联进一步支持了炎症相关基因变异可能对登革热临床异质性的潜在贡献。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明基因多态性可能影响登革热的特定临床特征,这可能为未来研究疾病严重程度的遗传基础以及指导登革热治疗和疫苗接种的个性化方法提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 需要更大规模的研究来阐明其潜在的生物学机制。提供的证据未报告研究结果的可推广性或潜在的混杂因素。

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热是一种重要的虫媒病毒疾病,编码炎症介质的基因多态性可能调节登革病毒(DENV)感染。因此,本研究旨在探讨IL-1β rs1143634、IL-8 rs4073和TNF-α rs361525多态性与登革病毒感染易感性以及临床表现和实验室参数之间的关联。方法 本研究在巴西戈亚斯州戈亚尼亚市进行,包括确诊登革病毒感染的个体。使用TaqMan检测和实时PCR对基因组中的IL-1β rs1143634、IL-8 rs4073和TNF-α rs361525多态性进行基因分型。采用逻辑回归、Fisher精确检验和Student t检验进行统计分析。根据基因型评估临床和实验室数据。结果 未观察到所评估的多态性与登革病毒感染易感性之间存在显著关联(p > 0.05)。同样,未观察到多态性与总体临床症状数量之间存在显著关联。然而,IL-8 rs4073多态性与血清转氨酶水平显著相关,AST(p = 0.002)和ALT(p = 0.040)。TNF-α rs361525多态性与血小板计数(p = 0.015)显著相关,IL-1β rs1143634多态性与腰痛(p = 0.040)显著相关。结论 IL-8 rs4073与AST和ALT水平的关联表明该多态性可能在登革热期间的肝脏受累中起潜在作用。此外,TNF-α rs361525与血小板减少以及IL-1β rs1143634与腰痛的关联进一步支持了炎症相关基因变异可能对登革热临床异质性的潜在贡献。需要更大规模的研究来阐明其潜在的生物学机制。

title: A multiplex serological survey highlights differences in population immunity to mosquito-borne diseases in Vanuatu, Pacific region, 2023.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Mosquito-borne pathogens are major emerging diseases and a growing public health concern in the Pacific, with occurrences linked to global increases, climate change and human mobility. To support risk assessment of arboviruses and malaria in Vanuatu, a seroprevalence survey was conducted on Espiritu Santo Island, Efate Island, Malekula Island and Tanna Island between October 2022 and May 2023. METHODS: Serum samples from 1,120 healthy participants aged 6-84 were tested for IgG against multiple arboviruses and malaria antigens using a multiplex microsphere immunoassay. RESULTS: Standardized seroprevalence (IgG) reached 34% for dengue virus (DENV), 3.2% for Zika virus (ZIKV), 8.6% for Ross River virus (RRV), 4.4% for Plasmodium falciparum, and 36% for Plasmodium vivax. Significant differences were observed between islands for ZIKV and P. vivax, and between age groups for DENV, RRV, and P. Seroprevalence was very rare or absent for West Nile virus, Japanese Encephalitis virus, Yellow fever virus and chikungunya virus. CONCLUSIONS: These results suggest silent circulation of RRV, consistent with findings in Fiji and French Polynesia, and confirm ongoing malaria transmission. In a context of climate change and rapid spread of infectious diseases, our data suggest a significant risk for Vanuatu's population if pathogens were introduced. This risk should be further assessed according to the presence and distribution of competent vectors and on their potential for local transmission.
journal: International journal of infectious diseases : IJID : official publication of the International Society for Infectious Diseases

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a multiplex serological survey in Vanuatu to assess population immunity to mosquito-borne diseases, including dengue virus (DENV). The survey, carried out between October 2022 and May 2023, involved 1,120 healthy participants from four islands. The results showed that seroprevalence for DENV was 34%, while it was very rare or absent for other related viruses such as Zika, West Nile, Japanese Encephalitis, and Yellow fever. The findings highlight the silent circulation of Ross River virus and ongoing malaria transmission, suggesting a potential risk for Vanuatu's population if new pathogens are introduced. The study's results are relevant for understanding local immunity patterns and informing public health strategies in the context of climate change and increasing infectious disease spread.

abstract_zh: 研究目的:蚊媒病原体是太平洋地区主要的新兴疾病,且随着全球增加、气候变化和人类流动而成为日益严重的公共卫生问题。为支持瓦努阿图地区虫媒病毒和疟疾的风险评估,于2022年10月至2023年5月期间在埃斯皮里图圣托岛、埃法特岛、马莱库拉岛和塔纳岛开展了血清流行率调查。研究方法:使用多联微球免疫分析法对1120名6至84岁健康参与者的血清样本进行检测,以评估其对多种虫媒病毒和疟疾抗原的IgG抗体水平。研究结果:标准化的血清流行率(IgG)在登革病毒(DENV)中达到34%,在寨卡病毒(ZIKV)中为3.2%,在罗斯河病毒(RRV)中为8.6%,在恶性疟原虫(Plasmodium falciparum)中为4.4%,在间日疟原虫(Plasmodium vivax)中为36%。在ZIKV和P. vivax之间观察到岛屿间的显著差异,在DENV、RRV和P.之间观察到年龄组间的显著差异。对于西尼罗河病毒、日本脑炎病毒、黄热病毒和寨卡病毒,血清流行率非常罕见或缺失。研究结论:这些结果表明RRV在瓦努阿图存在隐性传播,与斐济和法属波利尼西亚的研究结果一致,并确认了疟疾的持续传播。在气候变化和传染病快速传播的背景下,我们的数据表明,如果病原体被引入,瓦努阿图的人口面临显著风险。这种风险应根据合格的媒介的存在及其在本地传播中的潜在能力进一步评估。

title: Association of NS1 Antigen, IgM/IgG Antibodies with Haematological Indices and Inflammatory Markers in Suspected Dengue Cases: A Cross-sectional Study
abstract: Introduction: Dengue Virus (DENV) has been re-emerging as a major public health challenge in tropical and subtropical regions, including India, with increasing incidence, changing epidemiology, and seasonal outbreaks. Early diagnosis supported by laboratory markers is essential for effective clinical management and disease control. Aim: To evaluate the association of serological markers with haematological, biochemical and inflammatory parameters in clinically suspected cases of dengue. Materials and Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted from March 2025 to December 2025 at Adarsh Multispecialty Hospital, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. The study included 154 patients presenting with Acute Febrile Illness (AFI). DENV diagnosis was performed using an immunochromatographic kit for NS1 antigen and IgM and IgG antibodies from the serum sample. Haematological indices, Inflammation markers and liver function tests Serum Glutamic Pyruvic Transaminase (SGPT) and Serum Glutamic Oxaloacetic Transaminase (SGOT) were examined. Chi-square test was used for statistical analysis, and a p-value of <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: A total of 154 suspected Dengue Fever (DF) samples were collected, out of which 38 cases of dengue infection were confirmed. The highest positivity was seen in the age group of 21 to 30 years, 14 (36.8%), with males being more affected, making up 24 (63.2%) of the cases. The seasonal peaks happened during August and September, with 11/34 (32.4%) and 11/42 (26.2%) of cases, respectively. Testing for the NS1 antigen alone found 17/74 (23%) of infections, but combining NS1 and antibody testing raised the rate to about 20/73 (27.3%). Dengue patients showed significantly decreased platelet counts 35/38 (92.1%), White Blood Cell (WBC) counts 21/38 (55.26%), and also lymphocyte counts 20/38 (52.63%). Liver enzymes were also elevated (SGOT 161.58±372.44 U/L and SGPT 187.46±456.09 U/L). They also showed raised C-Reactive Protein (CRP) in 33/38 (86.8%) of cases and higher Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) in 23/38 (60.5%) of cases. Conclusion: Detection of the NS1 antigen with antibody testing gives more specific results. Significant increase in CRP levels and a drop in platelet levels in dengue-positive patients are early indicators of presumptive diagnosis. Integrated haematological, and inflammatory markers facilitate efficient risk stratification and enhance early dengue identification, enabling prompt clinical therapy during periods of peak transmission.
journal: Journal of Clinical and Diagnostic Research

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study aimed to evaluate the association of serological markers with haematological, biochemical, and inflammatory parameters in clinically suspected dengue cases. Conducted at Adarsh Multispecialty Hospital in Gujarat, India, from March to December 2025, the study included 154 patients with acute febrile illness. DENV was diagnosed using an immunochromatographic kit for NS1 antigen and IgM/IgG antibodies. Among the 154 samples, 38 were confirmed as dengue infections, with the highest positivity in the 21–30 age group and males being more affected. The findings suggest that these markers could be valuable for early detection and prompt clinical management during peak transmission periods.

title_zh: 疑似登革热病例中NS1抗原、IgM/IgG抗体与血液指标及炎症标志物的关联:一项横断面研究
source_body_en: Introduction: Dengue Virus (DENV) has been re-emerging as a major public health challenge in tropical and subtropical regions, including India, with increasing incidence, changing epidemiology, and seasonal outbreaks. Early diagnosis supported by laboratory markers is essential for effective clinical management and disease control. Aim: To evaluate the association of serological markers with haematological, biochemical and inflammatory parameters in clinically suspected cases of dengue. Materials and Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted from March 2025 to December 2025 at Adarsh Multispecialty Hospital, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. The study included 154 patients presenting with Acute Febrile Illness (AFI). DENV diagnosis was performed using an immunochromatographic kit for NS1 antigen and IgM and IgG antibodies from the serum sample. Haematological indices, Inflammation markers and liver function tests Serum Glutamic Pyruvic Transaminase (SGPT) and Serum Glutamic Oxaloacetic Transaminase (SGOT) were examined. Chi-square test was used for statistical analysis, and a p-value of <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: A total of 154 suspected Dengue Fever (DF) samples were collected, out of which 38 cases of dengue infection were confirmed. The highest positivity was seen in the age group of 21 to 30 years, 14 (36.8%), with males being more affected, making up 24 (63.2%) of the cases. The seasonal peaks happened during August and September, with 11/34 (32.4%) and 11/42 (26.2%) of cases, respectively. Testing for the NS1 antigen alone found 17/74 (23%) of infections, but combining NS1 and antibody testing raised the rate to about 20/73 (27.3%). Dengue patients showed significantly decreased platelet counts 35/38 (92.1%), White Blood Cell (WBC) counts 21/38 (55.26%), and also lymphocyte counts 20/38 (52.63%). Liver enzymes were also elevated (SGOT 161.58±372.44 U/L and SGPT 187.46±456.09 U/L). They also showed raised C-Reactive Protein (CRP) in 33/38 (86.8%) of cases and higher Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) in 23/38 (60.5%) of cases. Conclusion: Detection of the NS1 antigen with antibody testing gives more specific results. Significant increase in CRP levels and a drop in platelet levels in dengue-positive patients are early indicators of presumptive diagnosis. Integrated haematological, and inflammatory markers facilitate efficient risk stratification and enhance early dengue identification, enabling prompt clinical therapy during periods of peak transmission.

title: Haplotype diversity and variant switching associated with long-term transmission and outbreak dynamics of Dengue virus 3 genotype III lineages
abstract: Abstract Background Dengue viruses (DENV) evolve rapidly, resulting in highly diverse virus populations with varying epidemic potential. Even though DENV lineage replacement events are common in hyperendemic regions, often associated with outbreaks, the underlying fine-scale evolutionary processes are not well-described. Methods We analysed 5,443 inter-host envelope gene consensus sequences and 171 complete genomes of DENV-3 genotype III collected weekly in Singapore between 2015 and 2025. These datasets were analysed (i). to characterize the temporal dynamics of population structure from clades to haplotypes (ii). To determine unique genetic features and selection pressure and (iii). To infer the correlation between haplotype diversity and reported case numbers and vector abundance. Results There were two distinct lineages (3III_B.1 [clade III] and 3III_B.3 [clade V]) that established long-term transmission, overlapping two outbreaks in 2019–2020 and 2022. Clade V was more common than clade III in 2019–2020 and was displaced by clade III in 2021, expanding exponentially during the 2022 outbreak. Despite variant diversity, only a single variant of each clade was dominant during respective outbreaks. The dominant variant of clade III showed the highest number of haplotypes and accumulated non-synonymous substitutions in a step-ladder pattern, whereas that of clade V maintained a less pronounced evolutionary profile during the study period. The overall haplotype diversity peaked during high transmission periods, in parallel to abundance of the vectors. analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the long-term transmission and outbreak dynamics of Dengue virus 3 (DENV-3) genotype III lineages in Singapore between 2015 and 2025. It analyzes 5,443 envelope gene consensus sequences and 171 complete genomes to explore the temporal dynamics of population structure, genetic features, selection pressure, and the correlation between haplotype diversity and reported case numbers and vector abundance. The results reveal two distinct lineages, clade III and clade V, which overlapped two outbreaks. Clade V was more prevalent in 2019–2020 but was displaced by clade III in 2021, which then expanded during the 2022 outbreak. The dominant variant of clade III showed a higher number of haplotypes and accumulated non-synonymous substitutions in a step-ladder pattern, while clade V had a less pronounced evolutionary profile. Haplotype diversity peaked during high transmission periods, aligning with vector abundance. The study provides insights into the evolutionary mechanisms of DENV-3 genotype III and their implications for outbreak dynamics, but it does not include direct clinical or epidemiological outcomes, limiting its evidence strength to moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(登革病毒)进化迅速,导致具有不同流行潜力的病毒种群高度多样化。尽管在高度流行地区,登革病毒谱系替代事件很常见,通常与暴发相关,但其基础的微进化过程尚未被充分描述。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们分析了2015年至2025年间在新加坡每周收集的5,443个宿主包膜基因共识序列和171个完整的基因组 DENV-3基因型III序列。
elements_zh.methods: 这些数据集被用于(i)描述从谱系到单倍型的种群结构随时间变化的动态;(ii)确定独特的遗传特征和选择压力;以及(iii)推断单倍型多样性与报告病例数和媒介丰度之间的相关性。
elements_zh.main_results: 有两个明显的谱系(3III_B.1 [谱系III] 和 3III_B.3 [谱系V])建立了长期的传播,分别在2019–2020年和2022年与两个暴发重叠。谱系III的主导变异表现出最多的单倍型数量,并以阶梯式模式积累非同义替换,而谱系V的主导变异在整个研究期间表现出较不明显的进化特征。总体单倍型多样性在传播高峰期达到顶峰,与媒介的丰度同步。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在2019–2020年期间,谱系V比谱系III更为常见,并在2021年被谱系III取代,在2022年的暴发期间呈指数级扩张。尽管存在变异多样性,但在各自的暴发期间,每个谱系仅有一种变异占主导地位。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过突出单倍型多样性与暴发动态之间的关系,可以为监测和风险评估策略提供信息。它们还提供了对DENV-3基因型III进化模式的见解,这可能有助于理解其传播及其引发流行病的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究未报告研究设计或分析的局限性。证据强度中等,因为该研究基于序列数据,未包括直接的临床或流行病学结果。

title: Supportive care and herbal interventions in dengue fever: A critical appraisal of hydration, nutrition, and plant-based therapies
abstract: Dengue fever is a significant mosquito-borne viral disease in tropical and subtropical areas that causes a significant burden to public health systems and the affected communities. There is no definite antiviral treatment that can be used routinely in clinical practice, though there is growing interest in natural management, especially in endemic countries where home-based care, traditional medicine, and plant-derived adjuncts are widely used. The objective of this review is to critically evaluate evidence for natural and supportive management strategies in dengue fever, including oral hydration, nutritional support, rest, non-pharmacological symptom relief, and selected herbal interventions. A focused narrative review of clinical, preclinical, systematic-review, and guideline-based literature was conducted. Evidence supports oral hydration as the most established supportive measure in uncomplicated dengue, while nutritional support and rest may aid recovery. Carica papaya leaf extract may improve platelet counts, but this has not consistently translated into better clinical outcomes such as reduced bleeding, shock, hospitalization, or mortality. Evidence for other ethnomedicinal plants remains limited and largely preclinical. Overall, natural approaches may be useful only as adjuncts to standard supportive care and should not replace clinical monitoring or timely referral. Further well-designed trials are needed to clarify efficacy, safety, dosing, and standardization.
journal: Asian Pacific Journal of Tropical Medicine

analysis.summary_en: This review critically evaluates natural and supportive management strategies for dengue fever, focusing on oral hydration, nutritional support, rest, and selected herbal interventions. It highlights that oral hydration is the most established supportive measure, while other interventions, such as Carica papaya leaf extract, show promise in improving platelet counts but lack consistent evidence of better clinical outcomes. The review emphasizes the need for well-designed trials to assess the efficacy and safety of herbal interventions. It concludes that natural approaches should complement, not replace, standard supportive care and clinical monitoring.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于登革热,这是一种由登革病毒 1–4引起的蚊媒病毒性疾病。核心问题是批判性地评估自然和支持性管理策略的证据,包括口服补水、营养支持、休息、非药物症状缓解以及选定的草药干预措施,在登革热感染背景下的应用。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对临床、非临床、系统综述和指南类文献的聚焦叙述性综述。它未报告特定数据库、搜索日期或纳入标准,但包含对文献来源和综述方法的一般描述。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,口服补水是非复杂登革热最确立的支持性措施。营养支持和休息可能有助于恢复,但没有确凿证据表明草药干预措施,如木瓜叶提取物,能改善临床结果,如减少出血、休克、住院或死亡率。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 其他民族药物植物的证据仍然有限且主要基于临床前研究。从番木瓜叶提取物中改善血小板计数的证据尚未能一致地转化为更好的临床结果。综述强调需要进一步设计良好的试验来阐明草药干预措施的有效性、安全性、剂量和标准化。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 自然方法可能仅作为标准支持性护理的辅助手段,不应替代临床监测或及时转诊。需要进一步设计良好的试验以明确草药干预措施在登革热中的有效性、安全性、剂量和标准化问题。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于登革热,这是一种由登革病毒 1–4引起的蚊媒病毒性疾病。核心问题是批判性地评估自然和支持性管理策略的证据,包括口服补水、营养支持、休息、非药物症状缓解以及选定的草药干预措施,在登革热感染背景下的应用。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对临床、非临床、系统综述和指南类文献的聚焦叙述性综述。它未报告特定数据库、搜索日期或纳入标准,但包含对文献来源和综述方法的一般描述。

title: Entomological investigation of dengue outbreak in Raigarh, central India: Dominance of Aedes albopictus as the primary vector.
abstract: BACKGROUND OBJECTIVES: Dengue outbreaks pose a significant public health threat in Raigarh city, central India. During the 2023-2024 rainy season, there was a marked rise in febrile cases resembling dengue across urban areas. In response, ICMR-National Institute of Malaria Research, in collaboration with local health authorities, initiated an entomological surveillance campaign. This effort aimed to identify dengue vectors and implement rapid intervention strategies to mitigate disease transmission. METHODS: An entomological survey was conducted in 16 wards of Raigarh city. The study incorporated epidemiological data spanning nine years (2016-2024), along with a detailed month-wise analysis of dengue cases reported in 2023 and 2024. Vector density was assessed with House Index (HI), Container Index (CI), and Breteau Index (BI), to identify high-risk areas and predominant vector species. RESULTS: A total of 2080 water-holding containers were identified across 622 surveyed properties, for vector breeding. Among these, 67 (35%) were routinely used as household containers, while 124 (65%) were disposable items. Larval collections yielded 986 Aedes specimens, including 104 pupae, with Aedes albopictus accounting for 85% of the total, followed by Aedes aegypti (8%) and Aedes vittatus (5%). The entomological indices reflected a critical vector proliferation scenario, with HI of 17.35%, CI of 7%, and BI of 24.49. INTERPRETATION CONCLUSION: Targeted entomological surveillance, community awareness programs with interventions have contributed to a notable reduction in dengue case incidence. The findings establish Aedes albopictus as the predominant dengue vector in the region, alongside Aedes aegypti.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the dengue outbreak in Raigarh, central India, during the 2023-2024 rainy season. The research aimed to identify the primary vector species responsible for the outbreak and assess the entomological indices to guide intervention strategies. title_zh: 登革暴发在印度中部拉贾哈城的昆虫学调查:以白纹伊蚊为主导的媒介的优势地位
source_body_en: BACKGROUND OBJECTIVES: Dengue outbreaks pose a significant public health threat in Raigarh city, central India. During the 2023-2024 rainy season, there was a marked rise in febrile cases resembling dengue across urban areas. In response, ICMR-National Institute of Malaria Research, in collaboration with local health authorities, initiated an entomological surveillance campaign. This effort aimed to identify dengue vectors and implement rapid intervention strategies to mitigate disease transmission. METHODS: An entomological survey was conducted in 16 wards of Raigarh city. The study incorporated epidemiological data spanning nine years (2016-2024), along with a detailed month-wise analysis of dengue cases reported in 2023 and 2024. Vector density was assessed with House Index (HI), Container Index (CI), and Breteau Index (BI), to identify high-risk areas and predominant vector species. RESULTS: A total of 2080 water-holding containers were identified across 622 surveyed properties, for vector breeding. Among these, 67 (35%) were routinely used as household containers, while 124 (65%) were disposable items. Larval collections yielded 986 Aedes specimens, including 104 pupae, with Aedes albopictus accounting for 85% of the total, followed by Aedes aegypti (8%) and Aedes vittatus (5%). The entomological indices reflected a critical vector proliferation scenario, with HI of 17.35%, CI of 7%, and BI of 24.49. INTERPRETATION CONCLUSION: Targeted entomological surveillance, community awareness programs with interventions have contributed to a notable reduction in dengue case incidence. The findings establish Aedes albopictus as the predominant dengue vector in the region, alongside Aedes aegypti.

title: Unlocking the antiviral potential of chalcones: A computational approach against dengue virus NS5 Protein.
abstract: BACKGROUND OBJECTIVES: Dengue virus (DENV), a Flaviviridae member, poses a global health challenge due to the absence of effective antiviral therapies. The viral nonstructural protein 5 (NS5), responsible for RNA synthesis and methylation, is a validated drug target. This study aimed to identify potential chalcone-based inhibitors of the NS5 methyltransferase domain. METHODS: Forty chalcone derivatives from PubChem database were docked against the NS5 methyltransferase domain (PDB ID: 6KR2). The top six compounds were evaluated for drug-likeness (SwissADME) and toxicity (ProTox-II). Electronic properties were assessed using Density Functional Theory (DFT). RESULTS: Six chalcones showed better binding affinities (≥-7.0 kcal/mol) than the reference ligand S-adenosylhomo-cysteine (SAH, -6.2 kcal/mol), interacting effectively with the SAM-binding pocket. BL-1 had the strongest docking score (-7.8 kcal/mol) but showed toxicity concerns. BL-3 emerged as the most promising, with strong binding (-7.4 kcal/mol), excellent drug-likeness, low toxicity, and good synthetic accessibility. DFT analysis revealed that BL-4 had the lowest energy gap (ΔΕ=3.59 eV), indicating high reactivity, while BL-3 had a stable HOMO (-6.45 eV) and a moderate energy gap (ΔΕ=4.22 eV), suggesting a favorable balance of reactivity and stability. INTERPRETATION CONCLUSION: BL-3 shows strong potential as an NS5 methyltransferase inhibitor due to its optimal binding, safety profile, and electronic properties. It is recommended for further lead optimization and experimental validation as a candidate anti-DENV agent.

abstract_zh: 背景与目的:登革病毒(登革病毒,DENV)作为黄病毒科成员,由于缺乏有效的抗病毒药物疗法,对全球健康构成挑战。病毒非结构蛋白5(NS5),负责RNA合成和甲基化,是一个已被验证的药物靶点。本研究旨在识别针对NS5甲基转移酶结构域的潜在黄酮类化合物抑制剂。方法:从PubChem数据库中选取了40种黄酮类化合物衍生物,将其对接至NS5甲基转移酶结构域(PDB ID: 6KR2)。对前六种化合物进行了药物样性(SwissADME)和毒性(ProTox-II)评估,并利用密度泛函理论(DFT)分析其电子性质。结果:六种黄酮类化合物显示出比参考配体S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸(SAH,-6.2 kcal/mol)更强的结合亲和力(≥-7.0 kcal/mol),并与SAM结合口袋有效相互作用。BL-1具有最强的对接得分(-7.8 kcal/mol),但显示出毒性问题。BL-3则表现出最强的结合能力(-7.4 kcal/mol)、优异的药物样性、低毒性以及良好的合成可及性。DFT分析显示,BL-4具有最低的能量间隙(ΔΕ=3.59 eV),表明其高反应性,而BL-3具有稳定的HOMO(-6.45 eV)和适中的能量间隙(ΔΕ=4.22 eV),表明其在反应性和稳定性之间取得了良好的平衡。解释与结论:由于BL-3具有最佳的结合能力、安全性和电子特性,显示出作为NS5甲基转移酶抑制剂的强潜力。建议进一步进行先导化合物优化和实验验证,作为候选的抗登革病毒药物。

title: Fractional mathematical modeling of dengue fever (DF) in Afar region, Ethiopia
abstract: Dengue virus is a viral infection caused primarily by the bite of female Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, and it remains a significant global public health concern. In this study, we present a fractional mathematical model of dengue fever dynamics with harmonic-type incidence to investigate the impact of asymptomatic and hospitalized individuals on its dynamic behavior. We estimated key epidemiological parameters by fitting the model to real dengue data obtained from Afar Regional State of Ethiopia. This allows us to conduct an in-depth analysis of epidemic trends within the Afar region. Fundamental mathematical analysis is carried out, which confirms essential model properties including well-posedness of the solution. We derived both disease-free and endemic equilibrium points, and their stabilities are checked. We computed the sensitivity analysis of the basic reproduction number using the normalized forward sensitivity index to determine the most crucial parameters that contribute the most to the incidence of the disease. Numerical simulations are done to visualize the solution trajectories for studying the temporal evolution of all compartments to understand, predict, and control the disease. The simulation results indicate that vector control is mandatory because silent spread can have high mosquito infectivity.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究提出了一种包含谐波型发病率的分数阶数学模型,用于分析登革热的动态行为,利用了从埃塞俄比亚阿法尔地区获得的真实登革热数据。该模型关注所有组分的时间动态,以理解并预测该疾病的行为。
elements_zh.methods: 通过将模型拟合到埃塞俄比亚的真实登革热数据,估计了模型参数。进行了基本的数学分析,以确认模型的基本性质,包括解的适定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 模型被拟合到埃塞俄比亚的真实登革热数据,从而能够深入分析疫情趋势。模拟结果表明,媒介控制是必要的,因为无声传播可能具有较高的蚊虫感染力。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调媒介控制的必要性,以减轻无声传播对高蚊虫感染力的风险。本研究引入了一种包含谐波型发病率的分数阶数学模型,以更好地理解登革热的动态行为。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为埃塞俄比亚的监测和登革热控制提供公共卫生策略的依据。它们强调了媒介控制在防止无声传播和降低蚊虫感染力中的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于拟合真实数据的数学模型,可能在捕捉所有现实复杂性方面存在局限。由于依赖于基于模型的模拟,证据强度中等,不包括直接的实证观察。

title: CD5L as a potential immunomodulator in dengue severity.
abstract: BACKGROUND OBJECTIVES: CD5L (CD5 antigen-like) is a secreted glycoprotein involved in immune regulation, macrophage polarization, and lipid metabolism. While its role in inflammatory and bacterial diseases has been described, its function in viral infections such as dengue virus (DENV) infection remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate serum CD5L levels in dengue-infected individuals and investigate its association with serological markers and disease severity. A cross-sectional study involving dengue-positive and dengue-negative individuals was conducted to compare serum CD5L concentrations and assess correlations with NS1, IgM, IgG status, and disease severity. METHODS: Serum samples were collected from confirmed dengue-positive patients and dengue-negative controls. CD5L concentrations were quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and analyzed according to serological profiles (NS1, IgM, and IgG). Two-group comparisons were performed using the Mann-Whitney U test, and multiple groups were analyzed using the Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn's post hoc test. A p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant. RESULTS: CD5L levels were significantly elevated in dengue-positive individuals compared to dengue-negative controls (p < 0.05), with the highest levels observed in IgG-positive only individuals (p <0.001). No significant differences were seen in NSl-positive only or IgM-positive only groups, suggesting that CD5L upregulation is associated with IgG seropositivity rather than acute-phase markers. Similarly, CD5L levels did not significantly differ among individuals with combined serological markers (NS1 & IgM-positive, NS1 & IgG-positive, IgM & IgG-positive). Among IgG-positive only individuals, CD5L levels were significantly higher in non-severe dengue cases compared to severe dengue cases (p <0.05). No significant differences were observed in CD5L levels between severe and nonsevere NSl-positive only or IgM-positive only individuals. These findings suggest a potential association between increased CD5L and later stages of dengue virus infection with less severe outcomes. INTERPRETATION CONCLUSION: This study highlights CD5L's potential role in dengue pathogenesis, particularly its association with IgG seropositivity and non-severe disease. Further research is needed to clarify its mechanisms and evaluate its potential as a biomarker or therapeutic target in dengue virus infection.

source_body_en: BACKGROUND OBJECTIVES: CD5L (CD5 antigen-like) is a secreted glycoprotein involved in immune regulation, macrophage polarization, and lipid metabolism. While its role in inflammatory and bacterial diseases has been described, its function in viral infections such as dengue virus (DENV) infection remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate serum CD5L levels in dengue-infected individuals and investigate its association with serological markers and disease severity. A cross-sectional study involving dengue-positive and dengue-negative individuals was conducted to compare serum CD5L concentrations and assess correlations with NS1, IgM, IgG status, and disease severity. METHODS: Serum samples were collected from confirmed dengue-positive patients and dengue-negative controls. CD5L concentrations were quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and analyzed according to serological profiles (NS1, IgM, and IgG). Two-group comparisons were performed using the Mann-Whitney U test, and multiple groups were analyzed using the Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn's post hoc test. A p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant. RESULTS: CD5L levels were significantly elevated in dengue-positive individuals compared to dengue-negative controls (p < 0.05), with the highest levels observed in IgG-positive only individuals (p <0.001). No significant differences were seen in NSl-positive only or IgM-positive only groups, suggesting that CD5L upregulation is associated with IgG seropositivity rather than acute-phase markers. Similarly, CD5L levels did not significantly differ among individuals with combined serological markers (NS1 & IgM-positive, NS1 & IgG-positive, IgM & IgG-positive). Among IgG-positive only individuals, CD5L levels were significantly higher in non-severe dengue cases compared to severe dengue cases (p <0.05). No significant differences were observed in CD5L levels between severe and nonsevere NSl-positive only or IgM-positive only individuals. These findings suggest a potential association between increased CD5L and later stages of dengue virus infection with less severe outcomes. INTERPRETATION CONCLUSION: This study highlights CD5L's potential role in dengue pathogenesis, particularly its association with IgG seropositivity and non-severe disease. Further research is needed to clarify its mechanisms and evaluate its potential as a biomarker or therapeutic target in dengue virus infection.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的:CD5L(CD5抗原样)是一种分泌型糖蛋白,参与免疫调节、巨噬细胞极化和脂质代谢。尽管其在炎症和细菌性疾病中的作用已被描述,但在病毒性感染如登革病毒(登革病毒)感染中的功能仍不清楚。本研究旨在评估登革热感染个体的血清CD5L水平,并探讨其与血清学标志物和疾病严重程度之间的关联。采用横断面研究设计,比较了登革热阳性与阴性个体的血清CD5L浓度,并评估其与NS1、IgM、IgG状态及疾病严重程度的相关性。方法:从确诊的登革热阳性患者和登革热阴性对照组中收集血清样本。使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)定量CD5L浓度,并根据血清学特征(NS1、IgM和IgG)进行分析。两组比较采用曼-惠特尼U检验,多组比较采用克鲁斯卡尔-沃利斯检验结合杜恩事后检验。p值<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。结果:与登革热阴性对照组相比,登革热阳性个体的CD5L水平显著升高(p<0.05),其中仅IgG阳性个体的CD5L水平最高(p<0.001)。NS1阳性仅见组和IgM阳性仅见组中未观察到显著差异,这表明CD5L的上调可能与IgG阳性而非急性期标志物相关。此外,携带组合血清学标志物(NS1与IgM阳性、NS1与IgG阳性、IgM与IgG阳性)的个体之间CD5L水平无显著差异。在仅IgG阳性个体中,非重症登革热病例的CD5L水平显著高于重症登革热病例(p<0.05)。在NS1阳性仅见组和IgM阳性仅见组中,未观察到严重与非严重病例之间CD5L水平的显著差异。这些结果提示CD5L水平的升高可能与登革病毒感染的后期阶段及较轻的疾病结局有关。解释与结论:本研究突显了CD5L在登革热发病机制中的潜在作用,特别是其与IgG阳性及非严重疾病之间的关联。需要进一步研究以阐明其机制,并评估其作为登革病毒感染的生物标志物或治疗靶点的潜力。科学与公共卫生意义:这些发现表明CD5L水平的升高可能与登革病毒感染的后期阶段及较轻的疾病结局有关。这可能为未来研究CD5L作为登革病毒感染的生物标志物或治疗靶点提供依据。局限性与证据强度:本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计,无法建立因果关系。样本量和缺乏纵向数据可能也会影响研究结果的普遍性。证据强度为中等。

title: MicroRNA Responses Associated with Vector-Borne Diseases in Humans and Arthropod Vectors: A Systematic Review
abstract: Vector-borne diseases (VBDs) represent a significant public health challenge. Early and accurate diagnosis is crucial for effective disease management and control, with host-encoded microRNAs (miRNAs) emerging as promising disease biomarkers. This systematic review surveys research conducted on miRNA responses in disease vectors and human hosts of VBDs. A systematic search of four databases and manual searching identified 93 qualifying articles. Numerous VBDs were described, with the most common focus on dengue (21%; n = 15) and Chagas disease (11%; n = 8). Twenty-eight in vivo human studies have characterised miRNAs linked to VBDs, including African trypanosomiasis, Chagas disease, Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever, dengue, Japanese encephalitis, leishmaniasis, malaria, onchocerciasis, schistosomiasis, and Zika virus disease. Some overlaps of miRNA responses to infection were observed for Chagas disease (miR-208a), dengue (miR-146-5p), and schistosomiasis (sma-miR-bantam), while the majority exhibited minimal overlap. Studies addressing miRNA profiling of arthropod vectors predominantly emphasise ticks, with many efforts focusing on the miRNA profiles of tick saliva, salivary glands, nymphal ticks, and adults due to their pivotal role in pathogen transmission. This review reports a paucity of studies investigating miRNA biomarkers for VBD diagnosis and prognosis in humans and nominates the development of standardised protocols and validation across study cohorts as future directions.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review explores miRNA responses in human hosts and arthropod vectors of vector-borne diseases (VBDs), with a focus on dengue virus. The review identifies 93 qualifying articles and highlights the role of miRNAs as potential biomarkers for disease diagnosis. While some miRNA overlaps were observed for dengue and other VBDs, the majority of responses were distinct. The review underscores the need for more research on miRNA biomarkers for dengue and calls for standardised protocols and validation across study cohorts to improve diagnostic accuracy and disease management.

abstract_zh: 媒介传播疾病(VBDs)代表了重要的公共卫生挑战。早期和准确的诊断对于有效的疾病管理和控制至关重要,而与VBDs相关的miRNA(微小RNA)编码的miRNA(miRNAs)正逐渐成为有前景的疾病生物标志物。本系统综述调查了关于VBDs疾病诊断中miRNA反应以及人类miRNA反应的研究。通过对四个数据库的系统搜索和手动搜索,共确定了93篇符合条件的文章。描述了多种VBDs,其中最常见的研究对象是登革热(21%;n=15)和恰加斯病(11%;n=8)。已有28项人体在体研究描述了与VBDs相关的miRNA,包括非洲锥虫病、恰加斯病、克里米亚-刚果出血热、登革热、日本脑炎、利什曼病、疟疾、盘尾丝虫病、血吸虫病和寨卡病毒病。在恰加斯病(miR-208a)、登革热(miR-146-5p)和血吸虫病(sma-miR-bantam)中观察到了一些miRNA对感染反应的重叠,而大多数则表现出较少的重叠。针对节肢动物媒介的miRNA分析研究主要集中在蜱虫上,许多研究致力于分析蜱虫唾液、唾液腺、若虫和成虫的miRNA谱,因为它们在病原体传播中起着关键作用。本综述指出,关于VBDs诊断和预后的人类miRNA生物标志物的研究仍较为有限,并将标准化协议的开发和在不同研究中的验证作为未来的研究方向。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 这项系统综述调查了在VBDs中miRNA反应及其在人类宿主中的研究。媒介传播的疾病(VBDs)代表了重大的公共卫生挑战。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 通过四个数据库的系统搜索和手动搜索,共识别出93篇符合条件的文章。综述包括了关于VBDs中人类宿主和媒介媒介的miRNA反应的研究。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 28项体内人类研究已经确定了与VBDs相关的miRNAs,包括登革热。查加斯病(miR-208a)、登革热(miR-146-5p)和血吸虫病(sma-miR-bantam)的感染miRNA反应存在一些重叠,而大多数则表现出最小的重叠。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 提供的证据没有报告特定的争议或证据缺口,但指出对VBDs的miRNA生物标志物和人类预后的研究不足。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这项综述报告了对VBDs的miRNA生物标志物和人类预后的研究不足,并建议未来应制定标准化协议并在研究中进行验证。

title: EHD4 facilitates Zika virus infection by regulating extracellular vesicle-associated viral release and cell attachment.
abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) and other extracellular membrane-associated particles can contribute to viral dissemination; however, the host factors that regulate the composition and infectivity of EV-associated viral material remain incompletely understood. Here, comparative proteomic profiling identified Eps15 homology domain-containing protein 4 (EHD4) as a candidate host factor enriched in EV/virion-containing preparations from Zika virus (ZIKV)-infected Vero cells. Genetic ablation of EHD4 in HeLa cells impaired the propagation of ZIKV, Japanese encephalitis virus, and dengue virus serotype 2, whereas EHD4 re-expression restored viral propagation. In ZIKV-infected EHD4-knockout (KO) cells, a greater proportion of extracellular viral RNA was recovered in EV-enriched fractions than in wild-type (WT) cells. However, viral material recovered from KO-derived EV-enriched fractions exhibited reduced cell-binding activity and lower infectivity. Partial disruption of membrane integrity attenuated the difference in infectivity between WT- and KO-derived preparations, suggesting that membrane-associated components contribute to the functional properties of the associated viral material. ZIKV replicon assays showed no major effect of EHD4 on viral RNA replication. Immunofluorescence showed partial colocalization of EHD4 with CD63-positive compartments and ZIKV envelope protein. Transmission electron microscopy revealed that EHD4 loss did not affect multivesicular body (MVB) formation, but virus-like particles were readily observed in MVB lumens of WT cells and rarely in KO cells, suggesting that EHD4 promotes viral sorting into MVB luminal vesicles. Quantitative proteomic analysis further identified reduced abundance of a subset of membrane-associated proteins in KO-derived EV-enriched fractions. Collectively, these findings identify EHD4 as a host factor that influences the extracellular partitioning, composition, and infectivity of flaviviral material recovered in EV-enriched fractions. The molecular mechanisms underlying these effects remain to be defined.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of host factors in regulating the composition and infectivity of extracellular vesicle-associated viral material, particularly in the context of dengue virus infection, as the mechanisms governing this process remain incompletely understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used genetic ablation and re-expression of EHD4 in HeLa cells to assess its impact on the propagation of dengue virus, Japanese encephalitis virus, and ZIKV. It also examined ZIKV-infected EHD4-knockout and wild-type cells to compare extracellular viral RNA distribution.
analysis.methods: EHD4 was genetically ablated in HeLa cells, and its effects on viral propagation were tested using genetic re-expression. The study also performed comparative proteomic profiling, immunofluorescence, and transmission electron microscopy to analyze the role of EHD4 in viral sorting and extracellular vesicle composition.
analysis.main_results: Genetic ablation of EHD4 impaired the propagation of dengue virus, Japanese encephalitis virus, and ZIKV, while re-expression restored viral propagation. In ZIKV-infected EHD4-knockout cells, a greater proportion of extracellular viral RNA was found in EV-enriched fractions compared to wild-type cells.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that EHD4 plays a critical role in regulating the extracellular partitioning, composition, and infectivity of flaviviral material, particularly in EV-enriched fractions, highlighting a novel host-virus interaction mechanism.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the host factors that influence viral dissemination and infectivity, which could inform strategies for targeting viral spread and improving diagnostic or therapeutic approaches for dengue and related flaviviruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study primarily used in vitro models and did not include in vivo data, which may limit the generalizability of findings. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on abstract-only data and does not provide detailed mechanistic insights.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of EHD4 in regulating the extracellular dissemination and infectivity of flaviviruses, including dengue virus. Using genetic ablation and re-expression in HeLa cells, the research shows that EHD4 is essential for viral propagation and influences the composition and infectivity of extracellular vesicle-associated viral material. The findings suggest EHD4 facilitates viral sorting into MVB luminal vesicles, impacting viral release and cell attachment. While the study provides novel insights into host-virus interactions, its reliance on in vitro models and lack of in vivo data limit the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on abstract-only data and does not fully elucidate the molecular mechanisms involved.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨宿主因子在调控细胞外囊泡相关病毒材料的组成和感染性中的作用,特别是在登革病毒感染的背景下,因为该过程的调控机制仍不完全清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用HeLa细胞中EHD4的遗传性敲除和重新表达来评估其对登革病毒、日本脑炎病毒和ZIKV传播的影响。同时,还检查了ZIKV感染的EHD4敲除和野生型细胞,以比较细胞外病毒RNA的分布情况。
elements_zh.methods: 在HeLa细胞中遗传性敲除EHD4,并通过遗传性重新表达测试其对病毒传播的影响。本研究还进行了比较蛋白质组学分析、免疫荧光和传播电子显微镜,以分析EHD4在病毒分选和细胞外囊泡组成中的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: EHD4的遗传性敲除损害了登革病毒、日本脑炎病毒和ZIKV的传播,而重新表达则恢复了病毒传播。在ZIKV感染的EHD4敲除细胞中,比野生型细胞中更多的细胞外病毒RNA被发现存在于EV富集的组分中。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,EHD4在调控从EV富集组分中回收的黄病毒材料的细胞外分布、组成和感染性中起着关键作用,突显了宿主与病毒之间的一种新型相互作用机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为理解影响病毒传播和感染性的宿主因子提供了见解,这可能有助于制定针对病毒扩散的策略,并改进登革热及相关黄病毒的诊断或治疗方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究主要使用了体外模型,未包括体内数据,这可能限制了研究结果的普遍适用性。证据强度中等,因为其基于摘要数据,未提供详细的机制见解。

abstract_zh: 细胞外囊泡(EVs)和其他细胞外膜相关颗粒可能有助于病毒传播;然而,调控EV相关病毒材料组成和感染性的宿主因子仍不完全清楚。在这里,比较蛋白质组学分析鉴定了Eps15同源结构域蛋白4(EHD4)作为在寨卡病毒(ZIKV)感染的Vero细胞中含EV/病毒颗粒的准备中富集的候选宿主因子。在HeLa细胞中遗传性敲除EHD4会损害登革病毒、日本脑炎病毒和登革病毒 2型病毒的传播,而EHD4的重新表达则恢复了病毒传播。在ZIKV感染的EHD4敲除(KO)细胞中,比野生型(WT)细胞中更多的细胞外病毒RNA被回收在EV富集的组分中。然而,从KO衍生的EV富集组分中回收的病毒材料表现出较低的细胞结合活性和感染性。部分破坏膜完整性减弱了WT和KO衍生准备之间感染性的差异,这表明膜相关成分有助于相关病毒材料的功能特性。ZIKV复制子实验显示EHD4对病毒RNA复制没有显著影响。免疫荧光显示EHD4与CD63阳性区室和ZIKV包膜蛋白部分共定位。传播电子显微镜显示,EHD4的缺失不影响多囊泡体(MVB)的形成,但在WT细胞的MVB腔内可观察到大量病毒样颗粒,而在KO细胞中则很少,这表明EHD4促进病毒被分选到MVB腔内囊泡中。定量蛋白质组学分析进一步发现,在KO衍生的EV富集组分中,某些膜相关蛋白的丰度减少。综上所述,这些发现确定了EHD4作为调控从EV富集组分中回收的黄病毒材料的细胞外分布、组成和感染性的宿主因子。这些效应的分子机制仍有待阐明。

title: Strain-Dependent Cross-Neutralization of Closely Related Asian-Lineage Zika Viruses by Dengue-Immune Sera
abstract: Background: Zika virus (ZIKV) and dengue virus (DENV) co-circulate in tropical regions and elicit cross-reactive immunity. However, differential neutralization of closely related ZIKV strains remains unclear. This study characterizes the neutralization profiles of dengue-immune sera against DENV and two Asian-lineage ZIKV strains, P6-740 and PRVABC59. Methods: Sera from suspected dengue infections and from healthy donors were screened for anti-DENV IgM and IgG antibodies and anti-ZIKV IgM and IgG antibodies by ELISA and grouped. Neutralization against DENV serotypes and two ZIKV strains was quantified using the foci reduction neutralization test (FRNT). Complete genome sequences of ZIKV P6-740 and PRVABC59 were compared to identify amino acid differences. Results: Sera containing anti-DENV IgG showed higher neutralizing activity against both DENV and ZIKV than IgG-negative sera. Neutralization was also detected in some ELISA-seronegative samples. Across all immunological groups, neutralization titers were higher against ZIKV P6-740 than ZIKV PRVABC59. Among healthy donors with evidence of previous dengue exposure, 58% exhibited a ≥4-fold difference between the two ZIKV strains, of which 80% favored ZIKV P6-740. Among seronegative healthy blood donors, 45% exhibited a 4-fold difference, of which 89% favored P6-740. Four amino acid substitutions were identified in the envelope (E) protein. Conclusions: Dengue-induced immunity differentially neutralizes closely related ZIKV strains, with generally stronger activity against P6-740, suggesting that viral genetic variation may influence cross-neutralization outcomes.

title_zh: 由登革热免疫血清对密切相关的亚洲谱系寨卡病毒株进行的株系依赖性交叉中和作用

Among seronegative healthy blood donors, 45% exhibited a 4-fold difference, of which 89% favored P6-740. Four amino acid substitutions were identified in the envelope (E) protein. Conclusions: Dengue-induced immunity differentially neutralizes closely related ZIKV strains, with generally stronger activity against P6-740, suggesting that viral genetic variation may influence cross-neutralization outcomes.

title: Medicine–food homology and related natural products against mosquito-borne viruses: pharmacological evidence, mechanisms and translational priorities
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) cause substantial morbidity, yet specific antiviral treatment options remain limited. Medicine–food homology (MFH) materials and related natural products provide diverse chemical scaffolds for drug discovery. This critical narrative review examines their antiviral evidence, mechanisms and prospects for translation, distinguishing purified compounds from extracts, sulfated polysaccharides and semi-synthetic derivatives. Flavonoids and other polyphenols account for much of the literature. Reported effects span virion inactivation, entry, replication and maturation, as well as host pathways involving interferon responses, oxidative stress, inflammation and lipid metabolism. Several candidates combine cellular activity with biochemical or pathway-perturbation evidence, and a smaller group has been evaluated in animals. Clinical antiviral benefit has not been established for the candidates reviewed. The main development gaps concern reproducibility, selectivity and whether active concentrations can be reached in the tissues relevant to each infection. Priority should therefore go to candidates with defined composition, reproducible infectious-virus readouts and an exposure profile compatible with their intended use. This approach supports the development of direct antivirals, host-directed treatments and supportive interventions while keeping their distinct therapeutic claims clear.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of medicine–food homology (MFH) materials and related natural products as antiviral agents against Dengue virus (DENV) and related mosquito-borne viruses. It highlights the diverse chemical scaffolds these materials offer and their reported effects on viral processes and host pathways. However, the review notes that clinical antiviral benefits have not been established, and development gaps include reproducibility, selectivity and achieving active concentrations in relevant tissues. The implications suggest prioritizing candidates with defined composition and reproducible evidence for their therapeutic use.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于登革病毒(DENV)及其相关实体,如寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),这些病毒导致显著的发病率。核心问题是探讨医药同源(MFH)材料及相关天然产物作为这些病毒抗病毒药物来源的潜力,并强调区分纯化化合物、提取物、硫酸化多糖和半合成衍生物的重要性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是一项关键性叙述性综述,评估了MFH材料及相关天然产物的抗病毒药物证据、机制及转化前景。它涵盖了多种研究设计,其中一些候选物质已在动物中进行评估,而另一些则依赖于细胞活性和生化或通路干扰的证据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述指出,MFH材料及相关天然产物的报道效果涵盖病毒颗粒失活、入侵、复制和成熟,以及涉及干扰素反应、氧化应激、炎症和脂质代谢的抗病毒药物相关通路。同时,它强调了明确的组成、可重复的病毒感染读数以及与预期用途相容的暴露概况的重要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 主要的发展缺口涉及可重复性、选择性和是否能在与每种感染相关的组织中达到有效浓度。此外,所评估的候选物质尚未建立其临床抗病毒药物益处,表明其治疗效果缺乏明确的证据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 应优先考虑具有明确组成、可重复的病毒感染读数以及与预期用途相容的暴露概况的候选物质。这种方法支持直接抗病毒药物、抗病毒药物靶向干预及支持性干预措施的发展,同时保持其各自明确的治疗主张。

abstract_zh: 登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)导致显著的发病率,但针对这些病毒的特定抗病毒药物选择仍有限。医药同源(MFH)材料及相关天然产物为药物研发提供了多样化的化学骨架。本关键性叙述性综述探讨了这些材料的抗病毒药物证据、机制及转化前景,区分了纯化化合物、提取物、硫酸化多糖和半合成衍生物。黄酮类化合物及其他多酚类物质在文献中占据很大比例。报道的效果涵盖病毒颗粒失活、入侵、复制和成熟,以及涉及干扰素反应、氧化应激、炎症和脂质代谢的抗病毒药物相关通路。一些候选物质同时具备细胞活性和生化或通路干扰的证据,而一小部分候选物质已在动物中进行了评估。目前尚未建立所评估候选物质的临床抗病毒药物益处。主要的发展缺口涉及可重复性、选择性和是否能在与每种感染相关的组织中达到有效浓度。因此,应优先考虑具有明确组成、可重复的病毒感染读数以及与预期用途相容的暴露概况的候选物质。这种方法支持直接抗病毒药物、抗病毒药物靶向干预及支持性干预措施的发展,同时保持其各自明确的治疗主张。

title: Clinical and Laboratory Profile of Dengue Cases in a Tertiary Care Hospital, Dhaka
abstract: Background: Dengue fever is a painful, rapidly spreading vector-borne viral disease of global public health concern. The most recent dengue outbreaks in Bangladesh have demonstrated epidemiological patterns distinctly different from previous ones, with notable shifts in clinical presentation, serotype distribution, and disease severity.The aim of the study was to assess the clinical profile and laboratory findings of dengue patients presenting to a tertiary care hospital in Konia, Gazipur City, Dhaka. Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted in the Department of Medicine, Tairunnessa Memorial Medical College & Hospital, Dhaka, Bangladesh, from February to December 2025. A total of 100 dengue patients were enrolled by purposive sampling. Diagnosis was established on the basis of clinical and laboratory parameters. Ethical approval was obtained and written informed consent was secured from all participants. Complete blood count, liver function tests, renal function tests, NS1 antigen, and dengue IgM/IgG serology were performed. Platelet count, haemoglobin, and haematocrit were monitored serially. Data were expressed as mean ± SD, frequency, and percentage. Chi-square and Z-proportion tests were performed using IBM SPSS Statistics, Version 26.0. A p-value 1 was observed in 65% of patients versus

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究于2025年2月至12月在孟加拉国达卡的Tairunnessa纪念医学院附属医院医学系进行,涉及100例登革热患者。

elements_zh.main_results: 研究观察到,65%的患者p值为1,表明与某些临床参数存在显著关联。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为该地区登革热的监测和诊断提供信息,有助于及时干预和管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受到横断面设计和小样本量的限制,这可能会影响其推广性。获得了伦理批准和知情同意,并使用了统计检验进行分析。
